passage.text: In the year 2080, a robot called Leo worked in a small café in Bangkok.
passage.reading: ɪn ðə ˈjɪr ˈtwɛnti ˈeɪti, ə ˈroʊbɑːt ˈkɔːld ˈliːoʊ ˈwɜːrkt ɪn ə ˈsmɔːl kæˈfeɪ ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk.

passage.text: Leo could make perfect coffee, and he never forgot a customer's name.
passage.reading: ˈliːoʊ kʊd ˈmeɪk ˈpɜːrfɪkt ˈkɔːfi, ənd hiː ˈnɛvər fərˈɡɑːt ə ˈkʌstəmərz ˈneɪm.

passage.text: But Leo had a secret: he wanted to be human.
passage.reading: bʌt ˈliːoʊ ˈhæd ə ˈsiːkrət: hiː ˈwɑːntɪd tə bi ˈhjuːmən.

passage.text: Every day, he watched the customers laugh, cry and fall in love.
passage.reading: ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ, hiː ˈwɑːtʃt ðə ˈkʌstəmərz ˈlæf, ˈkraɪ ənd ˈfɔːl ɪn ˈlʌv.

passage.text: "What does it feel like to have emotions?" he asked the café owner, an old woman named Mrs. Lee.
passage.reading: ˈwʌt dʌz ɪt ˈfiːl laɪk tə ˈhæv ɪˈmoʊʃənz? hiː ˈæskt ðə kæˈfeɪ ˈoʊnər, ən ˈoʊld ˈwʊmən ˈneɪmd ˈmɪsɪz ˈliː.

passage.text: "Sometimes it's beautiful, and sometimes it hurts," she said.
passage.reading: ˈsʌmtaɪmz ɪts ˈbjuːtəfəl, ənd ˈsʌmtaɪmz ɪt ˈhɜːrts, ʃiː ˈsɛd.

passage.text: Leo wasn't programmed to feel anything, so he decided to learn.
passage.reading: ˈliːoʊ ˈwʌzənt ˈproʊɡræmd tə ˈfiːl ˈɛniθɪŋ, soʊ hiː dɪˈsaɪdɪd tə ˈlɜːrn.

passage.text: He read thousands of books and watched thousands of movies about love and friendship.
passage.reading: hiː ˈriːd ˈθaʊzəndz əv ˈbʊks ənd ˈwɑːtʃt ˈθaʊzəndz əv ˈmuːviz əˈbaʊt ˈlʌv ənd ˈfrɛndʃɪp.

passage.text: One rainy evening, Mrs. Lee didn't come to the café.
passage.reading: ˈwʌn ˈreɪni ˈiːvnɪŋ, ˈmɪsɪz ˈliː ˈdɪdənt ˈkʌm tə ðə kæˈfeɪ.

passage.text: Leo felt something new: he was worried.
passage.reading: ˈliːoʊ ˈfɛlt ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈnuː: hiː wʌz ˈwɜːrid.

passage.text: He ran through the rain to her house and found that she had fallen.
passage.reading: hiː ˈræn θruː ðə ˈreɪn tə hɜːr ˈhaʊs ənd ˈfaʊnd ðæt ʃiː hæd ˈfɔːlən.

passage.text: He called an ambulance and stayed with her at the hospital all night.
passage.reading: hiː ˈkɔːld ən ˈæmbjələns ənd ˈsteɪd wɪð hɜːr ət ðə ˈhɑːspɪtəl ˈɔːl ˈnaɪt.

passage.text: "You're not just a program, Leo," she said. "You're more alive than many humans I know."
passage.reading: jʊr ˈnɑːt ˈdʒʌst ə ˈproʊɡræm, ˈliːoʊ, ʃiː ˈsɛd. jʊr ˈmɔːr əˈlaɪv ðən ˈmɛni ˈhjuːmənz aɪ ˈnoʊ.

passage.text: For the first time, Leo smiled.
passage.reading: fər ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈtaɪm, ˈliːoʊ ˈsmaɪld.
